dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderate falcation characterized by a smooth concave spline curve along the posterior margin.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex classification with an obtuse pixel radius at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steeply ascending anterior margin at approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.1:1 ratio of maximum base width to maximum vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex curvature with a broad radius arc fitted to the anterior-dorsal boundary of the melon.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and robust beak with a low length-to-thickness ratio visible from the inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Clear obtuse interior angle where the melon slope transitions into the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small, distinct notch present on the trailing edge of the dorsal fin; subtle linear marks visible posterior to the ocular region.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant caustic light refraction patterns across the dorsal and lateral skin surfaces.
